name: Lilim
source:
A beastgirl who commands Animus' personal guard. She's known her boss for so long that the two of them are like sisters. Heeding Animus' latest whim, she too sets out for the new world... and is also sold into slavery.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ385224.html/]DLsite[/url]]
